prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a lively moment at a wedding reception. On the left, a bride in a white lace gown sits gracefully on a velvet chair, her posture relaxed yet elegant. Beside her, to the right, stands a groom in a sharp black tuxedo, leaning slightly toward her with a warm smile. In the center foreground, a small round table holds a tall crystal vase filled with red roses, its glass catching the ambient light. Next to the vase, a silver cake server rests on a white plate, gleaming under the chandelier. A young flower girl in a pink dress stands near the table, pointing excitedly at the cake server with her right hand. Behind her, an older woman in a blue sequined dress looks at the flower girl with an amused expression, her head tilted slightly. There is no confetti in the air, keeping the scene clean and focused on the intimate interactions. The bride’s left hand rests gently on the armrest, while the groom’s right hand is tucked into his pocket. The flower girl’s pink bow bobs as she gestures, drawing the older woman’s attention. The red roses in the center provide a vibrant splash of color against the neutral tones of the room. The velvet chair’s deep purple hue contrasts with the white gown, anchoring the left side of the composition. The crystal vase reflects the surrounding figures, adding depth to the center. The silver server’s metallic shine complements the groom’s cufflinks, creating a subtle visual link between the center and the right. The scene feels candid and spontaneous, frozen in time with crisp detail and natural colors.
